sources.snippet: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct is the latest vision-language model in the Tongyi Qianwen series. It achieves excellent visual perception, text understanding and generation, spatial reasoning, and intelligent agent interaction capabilities at the 4B parameter scale. It supports long contexts and video understanding, and has powerful OCR and multi-language processing capabilities.
